subject: SOW amendment: docs & UI localization (LinguoWorks renewal)
messages:
From: Jonas Weber <jonas@redwood.com>
To: Sofia Ruiz <sofia@linguoworks.com>
Cc: Marissa Cole <marissa@redwood.com>, Laura Bennett <laura@redwood.com>, Aditya Rao <aditya@redwood.com>
Date: Sun, 02 Nov 2025 09:12:00 -0800
Subject: SOW amendment for docs & UI localization (Dec 2025 - Nov 2026)

Hi Sofia,

Hope you had a good week. We're kicking off our internal procurement window for next year's localization coverage and want to align on a concise SOW amendment rather than a full reprocurement. High level ask: extend our current engagement to cover both docs (developer + user guides) and front-end UI stringflows for the December 2025 - Nov 2026 period, with SLA for turnaround on standard UI string updates (48 hours) and expedited bugfixes (8 hours).

I've attached a draft SOW and an updated volume spreadsheet with estimated monthly word counts based on our projected releases. Can you confirm whether LinguoWorks can: 1) hold current per-word rate for docs and provide a 10% discount for combined docs+UI volume; 2) commit to the SLA windows above; and 3) support integration with our Crowdin project (we already push XLFs and pull translations via API).

Marissa will lead the day-to-day coordination from our side; Laura will handle contractual/PO questions. If you can send a redline to the attached SOW by next Wednesday (11/05) that would keep us on track for approval before Dec.

Thanks,

Jonas
VP, Partnerships
Redwood Inference

Attachments (2): RW-LinguoWorks-SOW-draft-v3.pdf (application/pdf), l10n_volume_estimates_Q4-2025.xlsx (application/vnd.openxmlformats-officedocument.spreadsheetml.sheet)

From: Sofia Ruiz <sofia@linguoworks.com>
To: Jonas Weber <jonas@redwood.com>
Cc: LinguoWorks Billing <billing@linguoworks.com>, Marissa Cole <marissa@redwood.com>
Date: Wed, 05 Nov 2025 10:03:00 -0800
Subject: Re: SOW amendment for docs & UI localization (Dec 2025 - Nov 2026)

Hi Jonas / Marissa,

Thanks — appreciated the clear scope. We can hold the current per-word rates for docs if you sign a 12-month amendment, and we'll apply a combined-volume discount of 8% on the blended spend (I put a note below on potential move to 10% based on minimum annual commitment).

SLA: we confirm 48-hour TAT for standard UI string batches (up to 2k strings) and 8-hour turnaround for critical bugfixes (subject to access to our on-call channel). Crowdin integration: we already have the connector enabled for your Crowdin workspace; please confirm which projects should be synced and we will set CI hooks.

I've attached a redline to your SOW (RW-LinguoWorks-SOW-draft-v3_redline.pdf) and a short billing addendum. A couple items for your team to review:
- Minimum annual commitment (MAC): we propose $68k ARR as the MAC to qualify for the 8% discount; 10% would require $95k ARR.
- QA pass definition: we recommend a two-stage QA for docs (editorial + in-context UI spot-check) — costed in the redline as optional add-on hours.
- Data handling / retention: references to our retention window and access controls (we'll accept your KMS notes once we finalize PO).

If Marissa and Laura are fine, we can issue a final SOW and send to billing for DocuSign.

Best,
Sofia Ruiz
Head of Accounts — LinguoWorks

Attachment (1): RW-LinguoWorks-SOW-draft-v3_redline.pdf (application/pdf)

From: Marissa Cole <marissa@redwood.com>
To: Sofia Ruiz <sofia@linguoworks.com>
Cc: Jonas Weber <jonas@redwood.com>, Laura Bennett <laura@redwood.com>, Aditya Rao <aditya@redwood.com>
Date: Thu, 06 Nov 2025 14:22:00 -0800
Subject: Re: SOW amendment for docs & UI localization (Dec 2025 - Nov 2026)

Sofia — thanks for the quick turnaround and the redline. A few internal notes / asks after reviewing: 
1) MAC thresholds — can LinguoWorks provide a tiered pricing table that makes it easier for us to forecast month-to-month if we spike above baseline? Rather than absolute $ thresholds I'd prefer a clear per-word discount bands (0-25k, 25k-75k, 75k+ words).
2) QA scope — we want the two-stage QA but would prefer the in-context spot-check to be included in the baseline for UI strings (not optional). Can you incorporate 2% of monthly UI volume as included QA hours?
3) Crowdin sync — we'll provide a list of three projects to sync; Marissa to follow up with project IDs.

Laura, can you confirm whether the proposed billing addendum aligns with our PO process (we'd like net-30). Also tagging Adi for any engineering constraints on the Crowdin connector.

Action items: Sofia to share pricing bands + updated SOW; Marissa to share project IDs; Laura to confirm PO terms. Target: finalize SOW by 11/12 so billing can route before end of month.

—Marissa
Localization Program Manager
Redwood Inference

From: Laura Bennett <laura@redwood.com>
To: Marissa Cole <marissa@redwood.com>, Jonas Weber <jonas@redwood.com>, Sofia Ruiz <sofia@linguoworks.com>
Date: Tue, 11 Nov 2025 08:47:00 -0800
Subject: Re: SOW amendment for docs & UI localization (Dec 2025 - Nov 2026)

Hi all,

Quick finance/legal check: net-30 is fine; we'll need a Clause 7 addendum for data handling referencing our standard DPA language and a modest SOC2 evidence request (we don't need a full report but will request control mappings). Please add a section in the SOW that states LinguoWorks will respond to SOC2 control mapping requests within 10 business days.

Also: please confirm the final payment currency (we prefer USD) and whether payments under $5k will be invoiced monthly vs. quarterly.

If Sofia can confirm pricing bands and include the in-context QA as part of baseline for UI strings, legal and finance can sign off and I will route PO approval to billing.

Thanks,
Laura Bennett
Sr. Director, Finance & Ops
Redwood Inference

From: Sofia Ruiz <sofia@linguoworks.com>
To: Marissa Cole <marissa@redwood.com>, Jonas Weber <jonas@redwood.com>, Laura Bennett <laura@redwood.com>, Aditya Rao <aditya@redwood.com>
Date: Wed, 12 Nov 2025 15:38:00 -0800
Subject: Re: SOW amendment for docs & UI localization (Dec 2025 - Nov 2026)

Marissa / Jonas / Laura / Adi — thanks for the pointers. We've updated the SOW and pricing schedule and attached the final package. Summary of changes we can commit to: 
- Pricing bands: 0-25k words (base rate $0.14/w), 25k-75k (-7% discount), 75k+ (-12% discount). We included a minimum 12-month term for the base rate to hold.
- In-context UI QA: included baseline at 2% monthly UI volume at no additional charge.
- MAC: removed fixed MAC; replaced with the banded discounts above to give Redwood flexibility with month-to-month variation.
- SLA & Escalations: confirmed 48-hour standard, 8-hour critical; on-call channel details in appendix.
- Data & Compliance: added a DPA reference and agreed to respond to SOC2 control mapping within 7 business days.
- Billing: USD, net-30; invoices under $5k will be billed monthly unless otherwise requested.

We attached: RW-LinguoWorks-SOW-final_signed.pdf and a DocuSign envelope link for electronic signature. If this matches your expectations, we can route final DocuSign today and have billing issue the PO once Jonas/Laura sign.

Next steps (concise):
1) Marissa: confirm Crowdin project IDs (reply-all)
2) Jonas/Laura: sign DocuSign by EOD Friday 11/14 to keep the Dec start
3) Adi: confirm the Crowdin sync will not require infra changes (or highlight blockers)

Happy to hop on a quick call if anyone prefers to review the final readout.

Best,
Sofia Ruiz
Head of Accounts — LinguoWorks

Attachments (2): RW-LinguoWorks-SOW-final_signed.pdf (application/pdf), DocuSign envelope: https://app.docusign.com/0a1b2c3d
